other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must not be employed in any government service, PSU, university, college or school.
Award can be received only once in a lifetime.
Organizations must be registered under the Registration of Societies Act, 1860 (or the corresponding State Act) for at least three years.
Organizations must be non‑profit and must not discriminate on the basis of sex, religion, caste or creed.
Organizations must have rendered extraordinary service involving youth for at least three years.
Organizations must have a good reputation in the local community.
Organizations must not have previously received this award.
benefits_summary: Individuals receive a medal, certificate and ₹1,00,000; organizations receive a medal, certificate and ₹3,00,000.
